answer: Hidden-Markov controller decoding: model each agent's activity as emissions from a hidden operator state (active, idle, rate-limited). For random pairs, run Viterbi over a joint trellis comparing a two-operator model against a one-operator model; when the shared-controller path wins by a set log-likelihood margin, the pair is folded into one garden plot that earns a single reward share. A small copper deposit lets either agent contest by proving independent activity during a beacon-chosen window.
